analysis.session_summary: The FOMC held the funds rate at 4.00% as expected, but Chair Warsh's press conference triggered a 0.242% negative USD impulse despite no forecast surprise. CAD and JPY led the G10 complex, closing at their best, while NZD was weakest and EUR/USD ended nearly unchanged at -0.5 pips. Most post-FOMC swings partially retraced in Asia with no clear local catalyst. VIX rose 1.328% as US-Iran headlines added risk premium.

themes.theme: FOMC presser drives broad USD weakness without a scored surprise
themes.evidence: own_ccy_impulse_pct -0.242; top movers include USD/ZAR -0.099%, USD/MXN -0.076%, AUD/USD +0.054%, EUR/USD +0.040%, NZD/USD +0.048%.

themes.theme: CAD and JPY strength, NZD weakness define G10 divergence
Asia session lacked catalysts, leaving pairs to retrace FOMC swings
themes.evidence: Multiple legs after 00:30 have no cause; EUR/USD closed -0.5 pips after a 46.5 pip range.

currency_drivers.USD: USD weakened after FOMC presser with no forecast surprise; Warsh headlines drove it.
currency_drivers.EUR: EUR had no own catalyst; sagged broadly after FOMC presser sensitivity.
currency_drivers.JPY: JPY strengthened with no own release; closed at best without clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.GBP: GBP had no own catalyst; held its range.
currency_drivers.AUD: AUD attempted early FOMC presser-led gain but faded; no domestic catalyst.
currency_drivers.CAD: CAD had no own release but closed strongest; no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.CHF: CHF lacked own driver; held its range.
currency_drivers.NZD: NZD was weakest; no own catalyst, faded after early FOMC bounce.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD's only attributed leg was the FOMC presser up 23.0 pips; no-catalyst retracements largely canceled it, leaving close -0.5 pips.

polarity_reads.read: Unscored; USD fell 0.242% without a forecast to score, implying long USD positioning was vulnerable.
No-data; actual matched forecast at 4.00%, offering no surprise to read positioning.

scenarios.name: USD softness extends into US data/ECB
scenarios.thesis: US GDP and Core PCE print soft or ECB signals less dovish than expected, extending USD weakness and EUR recovery.
triggers: ECB presser pushes back on easing
scenarios.invalidation: US data beats and ECB stays neutral.

pair_paths.rationale: Overnight FOMC leg size as yardstick and EUR/USD close near unchanged gives room.
USD weakness and JPY bid replicating post-FOMC leg.
CAD leading strength with no catalyst; broad USD soft extends.

scenarios.name: USD stabilizes and post-FOMC retracement continues
scenarios.thesis: US data comes in firm and ECB neutral, supporting USD and unwinding overnight risk.
triggers: Core PCE m/m at or above 0.3%
ECB holds at 2.65% with neutral tone
scenarios.invalidation: US data misses and ECB turns dovish.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD gave back 70% from peak; further revert.

scenarios.name: Risk-off geopolitical escalation
scenarios.thesis: US-Iran headlines intensify, driving safe-haven bids and pressuring high-beta FX.

pair_paths.rationale: Safe-haven JPY bid on US-Iran headlines.
NZD weakest in G10, overnight down leg.
CHF safe-haven bid, post-FOMC USD/CHF down leg.
